endpoint.source: IAM project catalog network public endpoint for exact region/pool, or exact explicit override

request.scope: explicit IAM project/location auth view, never inferred from resource project_id
request.owner: project_id/tenant_id select explicit target owner on create, aliases must agree; omission uses token project. Shared/accessible reads preserve provider owner as metadata and retain caller scope in refs.
request.headers: optional If-Match revision_number=<exact nonnegative Integer> on update/delete
request.query: generated source-model attribute filters plus pinned Gophercloud tag query selectors, including tags/tags-any/not-tags/not-tags-any; separate generated response projection/sort selectors; repeated values preserved; pagination owns limit/marker
excluded_variants: subnet pools, segments and routed provider networks
port_security_enabled writes: Selectel explicitly disallows toggling traffic filtering

response.fields: all pinned Selectel vpc-go resource response fields plus source-bound tenant_id/QoS/VLAN and read-only port dns_assignment (ip_address, hostname, fqdn); no synthetic ownership or timestamp offset
response.resource_ref: ID must be nonempty for full responses; subnet/port network_id binds exact parent in same auth view. Projection may omit identity/parent and then list Ref is nil; exact Get retains request identity. Provider ref field discarded.
response.source_timestamps: raw strings, preserving fractional digits and absent timezone

errors.messages: fixed SDK diagnostics; raw Neutron message/detail discarded; no undocumented machine-code classification
errors.malformed_success: protocol_error or scope_mismatch; Accepted mutation receipt retains trustworthy identity when extracted
errors.ambiguous_mutation: unknown_outcome with retained receipt and no replay

wait.availability: unavailable; CRUD success is logical API acknowledgement, not dataplane health

recovery.availability: root Resource/Resume unavailable; exact Get observes identity but does not prove authorship of an unknown mutation
